about: Remote executable URLs reviewed to stay in shipped code (#27 AC6), each with the reason and the issue that removes it. scripts/build/remote-code.js fails on any other one, and on a row the package no longer has. The list only shrinks: test/build-security.test.js pins the rows it may hold. A template literal's expressions read as ${...}.

rows.reason: transformers.js's default for where ONNX Runtime loads its WASM files when the page doesn't set one. js/embeddings.js doesn't, so the first semantic search model load fetches them from jsDelivr. #9 hosts the runtime in the package and removes this row.
